examples.en: He can swim very fast.

examples.en: She is going to swim across the English Channel.

examples.en: The Channel is between England and France.

examples.en: She will set out from the French coast.
examples.zh: 她将从法国海岸出发。

examples.en: We saw a lighthouse on the coast.
examples.zh: 我们在海岸上看到一座灯塔。

examples.en: She hopes to set up a new world record.
examples.zh: 她希望创一项新的世界纪录。

examples.zh: 他打破了世界纪录。

examples.en: Debbie is a strong swimmer.
examples.zh: 黛比是个游泳能手。

examples.en: He is strong enough to carry the box.
examples.zh: 他很强壮，能搬动这个箱子。

examples.en: Many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
examples.zh: 许多人认为她一定能成功。

examples.zh: 他考试成功了。

examples.zh: 她父亲将焦急地注视着她。

article.en: Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
article.zh: 黛比·哈特准备明天横渡英吉利海峡。

article.en: She will set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
article.zh: 她将于早上五点钟从法国海岸出发。

article.en: Debbie is only eleven years old and she hopes to set up a new world record.
article.zh: 黛比只有十一岁，她希望创一项新的世界纪录。

article.en: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
article.zh: 她是个游泳能手，许多人认为她一定能成功。

article.en: Debbie's father will set out with her in a small boat.
article.zh: 黛比的父亲将乘一条小船与她一起出发。

article.en: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
article.zh: 明天，当她游往英国的长途中，他将焦急地注视着她。

article.en: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
article.zh: 黛比打算每两小时休息片刻。

article.en: Most of Debbie's school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast.
article.zh: 黛比的大部分同学将在英国海岸等候她。

article.en: Among them will be Debbie's mother, who swam the Channel herself when she was a girl.
article.zh: 他们当中还有黛比的母亲，她本人还是个姑娘时也曾横渡过海峡。
